Lines before the first snippet are not assembled.

Every section starts and ends with `.p2align 4`. llvm-mc gives `.text`,
`.data` and `.bss` an alignment of 16 by default, as rsasm does, but other
sections 1; the explicit alignment keeps the cases that are not about that
independent of it. The alignment at the end absorbs the `nop` llvm-mc adds
after a jump or branch (see tools/mc-diff/mips-programs.txt), so those are
written last in their section, where the extra word moves nothing. The last
case is about the default alignment, and has none.

=== hi and lo of a label in another section
        .text
        .p2align 4
        lui     $a0, %hi(msg)
        addiu   $a0, $a0, %lo(msg)
        lw      $a1, %lo(msg)($a0)
        sw      $a1, %lo(msg + 4)($a0)
        .p2align 4
        .data
        .p2align 4
        .space  0x8000
msg:    .word   1, 2
        .p2align 4

=== hi and lo where the low half is negative @ 0x407ff0
        .text
        .p2align 4
here:
        lui     $a0, %hi(there)
        addiu   $a0, $a0, %lo(there)
        lui     $a1, %hi(here)
        addiu   $a1, $a1, %lo(here)
there:
        .p2align 4

=== la of a label
        .text
        .p2align 4
        la      $a0, value
        la      $a1, value + 0x10000
        .p2align 4
        .data
        .p2align 4
        .space  0x9000
value:  .word   0x11223344
        .p2align 4

=== jal and j to labels in another section
        .text
        .p2align 4
start:
        jal     func
        .p2align 4
        .section .text.func, "ax"
        .p2align 4
func:
        j       start
        .p2align 4

=== a branch into another section
        .text
        .p2align 4
entry:
        bal     helper
        .p2align 4
        .section .text.helper, "ax"
        .p2align 4
helper:
        bal     entry
        .p2align 4

=== data across sections
        .text
        .p2align 4
entry:
        .word   0
        .section .text.helper, "ax"
        .p2align 4
helper:
        .word   0
        .data
        .p2align 4
        .word   entry
        .word   helper - .

        .p2align 4

=== refused: jal across a 256 MB region boundary @ 0xffffff0
        .text
        .p2align 4
        jal     far
        .p2align 4
        .section .text.far, "ax"
        .p2align 4
far:
        .word   0

=== jal to a number takes its region from the jump @ 0xffffff0
        .text
        .p2align 4
        jal     0x10000010
        .p2align 4

=== sections start at their default alignment
        .text
        .byte   1
        .data
        .byte   2
        .section .rodata
        .byte   3
